Reopening condition: a condition-specific pathway with its own published evidence base distinct from the atopic-dermatitis literature (for example, an eczema-specific cohort outcome not explained by the AD evidence) would justify re-screening this identity.

SCOPE SPLIT DECISION 2026-09-28 - NOT CONSOLIDATED, and the identity-duplication finding is RETRACTED as erroneous at the evidence level. Batches 80 and 82 recorded eczema and atopic-dermatitis-eczema as IDENTITY-DUPLICATION, 'open identities for the same disease', and this file's own note called the identity 'a common clinical synonym for atopic dermatitis rather than a distinct disease process'. The registered evidence contradicts that reading. The repo's own qualified-human-VERIFIED route into this identity is psoriasis -> eczema at POST_SURGICAL_OR_TREATMENT, whose source is the prospective biologic-registry study 'Risk of Paradoxical Eczema in Patients Receiving Biologics for Psoriasis' (JAMA Dermatol. 2024;160(1):71-79, PMID 38055239, verified 2026-08-19) and whose guard states that eczema must NOT be inferred from psoriasis itself and that exposure to the implicated biologic is required. PARADOXICAL ECZEMA IS A DRUG-INDUCED ECZEMATOUS ERUPTION AND IS NOT ATOPIC DERMATITIS. The two identities therefore hold two different disease routes - this identity the iatrogenic eczematous eruption, atopic-dermatitis-eczema the atopic march to asthma - and no single merged identity can preserve both qualified-human-verified mappings. Consolidating into atopic-dermatitis-eczema would assert that biologic therapy causes ATOPIC DERMATITIS, a category error on a human-approved mapping; consolidating in the other direction would assert that eczema in general causes asthma, a widening beyond the atopic-dermatitis-phenotype evidence. SCOPE BOUNDARY RECORDED: this identity owns the generic and iatrogenic eczematous eruptions including paradoxical eczema; atopic-dermatitis-eczema owns the atopic-disease route. No claim routed here may be extended to atopic dermatitis, and no claim there may be widened to generic eczema. The catalog aliases were tightened accordingly: this identity now carries 'paradoxical eczema' and 'drug-induced eczema', and the sibling now carries 'atopic dermatitis'. REOPENING CONDITION MET AND THIS NOTE IS ITS RECORD: this file's earlier note set a reopening condition of 'a condition-specific pathway with its own published evidence base distinct from the atopic-dermatitis literature (for example, an eczema-specific cohort outcome not explained by the AD evidence)', and the verified paradoxical-eczema biologic-registry route is exactly such a pathway, so the duplicate-scope deferral is closed rather than left pending.

The negative screen of 2026-09-23 is unchanged and still stands: no outgoing eczema edge was authored, the insomnia direction located was insomnia-to-AD and therefore incompatible with an outgoing eczema-to-insomnia edge and blocked by the parallel-pathway ban, and the pediatric multi-inflammatory-skin-disease record was psoriasis-anchored and supplies no condition-specific outgoing anchor. The scope split does not revive any of those routes.
